heroSummary: RCSS students start Monday, August 24, 2026, and finish Wednesday, June 9, 2027, with a two-hour early dismissal. RCSS lists Spring Annual Leave from March 29 through April 1; students are also off April 2 for a Workday, and the fourth quarter begins April 5.

customSections.content: RCSS uses Workday, Annual Leave, and Holiday labels for dates when students do not attend. The table groups adjacent days off so families can see the full no-school stretch. RCSS’s official labels are shown alongside each period.

rows: November 25 is a Workday; November 26–27 are Holidays. Students return Monday, November 30.
The next scheduled school day is Monday, January 4.
The second semester and third quarter begin Thursday, January 21.
March 26 is a Holiday, March 29–April 1 is Annual Leave, and April 2 is a Workday. The fourth quarter begins Monday, April 5.

customSections.label: How RCSS Handles Inclement Weather Make-Up Days
customSections.content: The official calendar says RCSS will absorb the first five closure days. After those five days, the district may use up to five remote-learning days if necessary. The PDF also lists make-up dates. Don’t assume a listed Workday becomes a school day unless RCSS announces the change.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Randolph County School System start school in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The first day for RCSS students is Monday, August 24, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is RCSS spring break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: RCSS lists Spring Annual Leave from March 29 through April 1, 2027. Students are also off March 26 for a Holiday and April 2 for a Workday; the fourth quarter begins Monday, April 5.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for RCSS in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The last student day is Wednesday, June 9, 2027, with a two-hour early dismissal.

calendarFaqs.q: Do RCSS students have school on teacher workdays?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The Workdays shown on this page are student no-school dates unless RCSS activates one under its weather make-up schedule or announces another change.

calendarFaqs.q: How does RCSS handle weather make-up days?
calendarFaqs.a: The calendar says RCSS will absorb the first five closure days, then may use up to five remote-learning days if necessary. The calendar also lists November 25, January 20, February 15, and April 2 as make-up dates. Wait for RCSS confirmation before treating any Workday as a student attendance day.

calendarFaqs.q: Where can I find the official RCSS calendar PDF?
calendarFaqs.a: Use the official PDF button on this page or open the Randolph County School System calendars page. The 2026–27 PDF was approved February 10, 2025.
